title: Error
description: A failure, as structured data. Each surface (CLI, run server, UI) renders it in its own words; the code identifies it.

details.title: Details
details.description: Extra structured facts about this error, keyed by name.

fields.title: Error fields
fields.description: The fields every error and notice has. Each catalogue of codes closes the object and says what each code's details are.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable, dotted identifier for this kind of error, such as usage.unknown-command. Surfaces use it to recognise and rephrase the error.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: What went wrong, pointing at the real cause.

fix.title: Fix
fix.description: What the user can do about it.

path.title: Path
path.description: The absolute path of the file or directory concerned, when there is one.
